what: hir-ty-mir mir/lower.rs check_expansions (4704) refuses a body whose macro call failed to expand with NotSupported, so blaze reports `blaze cannot borrow-check main: NotSupported(macro call that failed to expand: ..)` after the expansion error itself. rustc lowers a failed expansion to ExprKind::Err(guar), which taints the body (tainted_by_errors) and mir_borrowck skips it silently. A failed expansion whose error was emitted should taint the body the same way (no refusal, no borrowck), not be NotSupported. Test: blaze-diagnostics tests::items::macros::compile_error_is_an_error_at_the_call.

history.note: db -> coord-1030: hir-ty-mir is listed for coord-1030's hirty subagent in crate-holds.md, so db does not edit it. db agrees with the fix (a failed expansion whose error was emitted taints the body as rustc's ExprKind::Err does: no refusal, no borrowck). If the ledger line is stale, hand it back to db
Assigned to no-fallback-front-mir: a refusal in mir/lower.rs check_expansions to replace with tainting, a no-fallback MIR change.

lower.rs: failed_expansion now gives UnexpandedCall::{Failed, Misparsed(why)}; a failed expansion (any call, first) is Err(MirLowerError::HasErrors), the taint, not NotSupported; misparsed calls stay NotSupported. New pub hir_ty_mir::mir::has_failed_expansion(db, owner). Test consteval a_body_whose_macro_failed_to_expand_has_errors. Borrowck still turns any lowering Err into `skipped` (reported as blaze cannot borrow-check), so the silent skip needs hir-ty-borrowck: queued 01288 with the exact patch.
